PS1:constructor.d: Constructor is a 1997 video game released originally for MS-DOS computers and later ported to the PlayStation and macOS It was developed by System 3 and published by Acclaim Entertainment. In the game, packed with humorous undertones, the player controls a construction company in a map split between several estates, and must deal with other teams to win the game. On July 31, 2015, System 3 announced that Constructor was getting an HD re-release on consoles and PC in 2016, but it was delayed to May 26, 2017.
